body:
Added human/bot card comments in the shared editor and CLI/API. Each comment records author name, kind, timestamp and Markdown body in the card's own Markdown source. Ordinary edits preserve history; conditional append and durable replay prevent overwritten or duplicated comments. Main card surfaces show counts, and search/context include comments.

The full local gate, comments/autosave/editor/card/focus/events browser suites and broad HTTPS smoke pass. Tests cover source persistence, restart/retry, concurrent conflicts, unsent drafts, safe rendering and mobile widths. The existing manual app is rebuilt and restarted at the same HTTPS address with identity and data retained. Physical iPhone acceptance remains open. Evidence: progress/2026-09-26-card-comments.md.

metadata.summary: Add source-owned card comments with human and bot authors
